name: base_long_p13
description: The base settings of ctde_sweep_p13 (its best arm, held-out VTI 0.42 at 960k and still rising) trained longer in all three paradigms: 1.2M steps (what fits blackwell1's 4 h limit for CTCE, the slowest), three seeds, to see how far each paradigm gets towards the money ceiling and whether the seeds agree (L-14, L-17). Setup: 1-LV-rural3--2-sw with 13 participants, German 2024 prices, bill reward, the paper's 42 signals, power flow, one-day episodes that end, no terminal value. max_parallel 9: blackwell1 allows 4096 threads per user and a run takes about 340.
